verdict.rationale: The documented API covers a broad share of UI functions: corporate card listing and block/unblock, VCN issue, top-up, reveal and cancel, bills, balance, statements and reconciliation, categories, cost centers, suppliers, users and receipts. However, several UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent: Pix, boleto issuance and payment, batch payments, the approvals area, the international dollar account, AI spend insights, and corporate card issuance. Credentials are also managed in Internet Banking rather than via the API. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for Pix, boletos, batch payments, approvals, the international account, analytics and insights, and corporate card issuance; an explicit statement of API/UI parity; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Issue, look up, top up, reveal and cancel virtual cards (VCN) for travel bookings (hotel and air) and uses you define.
Access card and bank statements, download receipts, update and reconcile transactions.
List, update, and delete users; manage access profiles and invites.
List, block, and unblock corporate cards.
